annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国土交通省 物流・自動車局 技術・環境政策課 (MLIT)
key_provisions_or_claims: Robots not treated as pedestrians-like vehicles are road vehicles (motorized bicycles) under the Road Transport Vehicle Act.
Standards relaxation certification allows exemption from safety standards other than emissions and noise, if alternative safety measures are taken.
Walking robots at up to 6 km/h in pedestrian areas are treated as Class 1 motorized bicycles.
Applicants file with regional transport bureaus, with safety-measure documents and a compliance pledge.
Safety considerations include communication delay, emergency stop, manual intervention, and hacking prevention.
annotation.summary_en: MLIT briefing slides explaining Japan's standards-relaxation certification system under the Road Transport Vehicle Act for public-road trials of autonomous delivery robots, walking robots and remote-operated driving systems. It covers vehicle classification, application procedure, required documents and safety-measure considerations.
